# Load data


## Define CTLs and Tumour-bearing

```{r, include=FALSE}
ctl_samples <- c(
  "Agca_snLLC_CTL",
  "Brown_scLLC_CTL",
  "Kim_scB16F10_CTL",
  "Pryce_scC26_CTL",
  "Pryce_scKPP_CTL",
  "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"
)

early_tb_samples <- c(
  "Brown_scLLC_2w",
  "Brown_scLLC_2.5w"
)

endpoint_tb_samples <- c(
  "Agca_snLLC_LLC",
  "Brown_scLLC_3.5w",
  "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10",
  "Pryce_scC26_C26",
  "Pryce_scKPP_KPP",
  "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"
)



sc_combined$condition <- NA

sc_combined$condition[sc_combined$orig.ident %in% ctl_samples] <- "Control"

sc_combined$condition[sc_combined$orig.ident %in% early_tb_samples] <- "Early tumour-bearing"

sc_combined$condition[sc_combined$orig.ident %in% endpoint_tb_samples] <- "Endpoint tumour-bearing"

rm(ctl_samples, early_tb_samples, endpoint_tb_samples)
```



# Load nichenet data (httpS://zenodo.org/record/7074291)

```{r, include=FALSE}
### LR network
lr_network <- readRDS("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/nichenet_databases/lr_network_mouse_21122021.rds")

### weighted networks (lr_sig is interactions and weights in LR signaling network, gr is interactions and weights in gene regulator network)
weighted_networks <- readRDS("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/nichenet_databases/weighted_networks_nsga2r_final_mouse.rds")

weighted_networks_lr = weighted_networks$lr_sig %>%
  inner_join(lr_network, by = c("from", "to"))

### ligand target matrix (probability that a ligand regulates gene expression in receiver cells)
ligand_target_matrix <- readRDS("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/nichenet_databases/ligand_target_matrix_nsga2r_final_mouse.rds")
```



# Define sender and receiver cell types

### MUSCLE SENDERS/RECEIVERS "Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Neutrophils", "NK cells"

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

sender_cells <- c("Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Neutrophils", "NK cells")

receiver_cells <- c("Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Neutrophils", "NK cells")
```



# Get genes expressed from sender and receiver cells 

```{r, include=FALSE}
list_expressed_genes_sender = sender_cells %>%
  unique() %>%
  lapply(get_expressed_genes, sc_combined, 0.10) # expressed in 10%

sender_genes = list_expressed_genes_sender %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

receiver_genes = get_expressed_genes(receiver_cells, sc_combined, pct = 0.10)

background_genes = receiver_genes %>%
  .[. %in% rownames(ligand_target_matrix)]
```



# Define gene set of interest (genes in receiver cells that are affected by ligands from the sender cells)

## Subset receiver cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
muscle_immune <- subset(sc_combined, idents = c("Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Neutrophils", "NK cells"))
```


## Differentially expressed receiver genes in receiver cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(muscle_immune) <- "condition"

de_receiver_genes <- FindMarkers(muscle_immune, ident.1 = "Endpoint tumour-bearing", ident.2 = "Control", min.pct = 0.10)

de_receiver_genes = de_receiver_genes %>%
  filter(p_val_adj <= 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) >= 0.2)

de_receiver_gene_names <- rownames(de_receiver_genes)

de_receiver_gene_names = de_receiver_gene_names %>%
  .[. %in% rownames(ligand_target_matrix)]
```


## Identify potential ligands in the sender cell population that bind to receptor(s) in the receiver cell population

```{r, include=FALSE}
ligands = lr_network %>%
  pull(from) %>%
  unique()

receptors = lr_network %>%
  pull(to) %>%
  unique()

expressed_ligands = intersect(ligands, sender_genes)
expressed_receptors = intersect(receptors, receiver_genes)

potential_ligands = lr_network %>%
  filter(from %in% expressed_ligands & to %in% expressed_receptors) %>%
  pull(from) %>%
  unique()
```



# NicheNet ligand activity analysis (rank ligands based on presence of target genes)

### NOTE - AUPR (area under the precision-recall curve) used to rank ligand activity (between ligand's target prediction and observed transcriptional response)

```{r, include=FALSE}
ligand_activities = predict_ligand_activities(geneset = de_receiver_gene_names, background_expressed_genes = background_genes, ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix, potential_ligands = potential_ligands)

# Arrange aupr from highest to lowest
ligand_activities = arrange(ligand_activities, -aupr_corrected)

# To get all ligands
ligand_activities_genes <- unique(ligand_activities$test_ligand)
```


## Filter for ligands found to be enriched from muscle immune cells (Monocytes, Macrophages, Neutrophils, NK cells) to muscle immune cells (Monocytes, Macrophages, Neutrophils, NK cells) using CellChat

### Enrichment for TGFb, GAS, PROS, VISFATIN, CXCL, ANNEXIN pathways found via cellchat

```{r, include=FALSE}
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse

cellchat_enriched_pathways <- c("TGFb", "GAS", "PROS", "VISFATIN", "CXCL", "ANNEXIN")

cellchat_subset <- subset(CellChatDB$interaction,
                    pathway_name %in% cellchat_enriched_pathways)

cellchat_ligands <- unique(cellchat_subset$ligand)
```

### Filter ligand_activities_genes for those in cellchat_ligands

```{r, include=FALSE}
ligand_activities_genes_cellchat <- ligand_activities_genes[ligand_activities_genes %in% cellchat_ligands]
```


## Once ligand activities are found, can do dotplot on the top genes to see which cells are expressing those ligands

```{r}
Idents(muscle_immune) <- "seurat_clusters"

DotPlot(muscle_immune, features = ligand_activities_genes_cellchat) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1, face = "italic")) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("red", "white", "blue")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```



# Infer the ligands with the highest regulatory potentials

```{r, include=FALSE}
# What ligands lead to the expression of target genes
active_ligand_target_links_df = ligand_activities_genes_cellchat %>%
  lapply(get_weighted_ligand_target_links, geneset = de_receiver_gene_names, ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  drop_na()

# Matrix of ligands (column names) and target genes (rownames) interaction weights

quantile_value <- quantile(active_ligand_target_links_df$weight, probs = 0.90) # This takes the top 10% strongest regulatory links instead of using an arbitrary cutoff!

active_ligand_target_links = prepare_ligand_target_visualization(ligand_target_df = active_ligand_target_links_df, ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix, cutoff = quantile_value)
```


## Heatmap ligands --> target genes

### Filter for ligands expressed in sender cells with an average expression >= 0.25 in >= 25% of cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Extract log-normalized data
sender_mat <- Seurat::GetAssayData(muscle_immune, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[ligand_activities_genes_cellchat, ]

# Compute average expression and % expressing
sender_expr_stats <- data.frame(
  ligand      = ligand_activities_genes_cellchat,
  avg_exp     = Matrix::rowMeans(sender_mat), # average log-normalized expression
  pct_express = Matrix::rowSums(sender_mat > 0) / ncol(sender_mat) # fraction of cells with >0
)

# Filter by thresholds (example: avg >= 0.25 and pct >= 25%)
sender_expressed_ligands <- sender_expr_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_exp >= 0.25, pct_express >= 0.25)

sender_expr_stats   # all ligands with values
sender_expressed_ligands <- sender_expressed_ligands$ligand # ligands meeting thresholds
```

### Heatmap with ligands confirmed to be expressed in sender cells

```{r}
order_ligands = intersect(ligand_activities_genes_cellchat, colnames(active_ligand_target_links)) %>% 
  rev() %>%
  make.names()

order_targets = active_ligand_target_links_df$target %>%
  unique() %>%
  intersect(rownames(active_ligand_target_links)) %>%
  make.names()

rownames(active_ligand_target_links) = rownames(active_ligand_target_links) %>%
  make.names()

colnames(active_ligand_target_links) = colnames(active_ligand_target_links) %>%
  make.names()

vis_ligand_target = active_ligand_target_links[order_targets, order_ligands] %>%
  t()

p_ligand_target_network = vis_ligand_target %>%
  make_heatmap_ggplot("Ligands", "Predicted target genes", color = "red", legend_position = "right", x_axis_position = "bottom", legend_title = "Regulatory potential") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic"), axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.8)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey95", high = "red", limits = c(0, 0.3))

p_ligand_target_network
```

```{r}
ligand_summary <- data.frame(
```

```{r}
ligand_target_genes <- vis_ligand_target %>%

ligand_target_gene_list
```

# Receptors receiving signals from most active ligands

### Specify receptors for the Tgfb1, Cxcl12 ligands

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Your ligands of interest
top_ligands <- c("Tgfb1", "Cxcl12")

# Extract ligand–receptor table from CellChatDB
lr_pairs <- CellChatDB$interaction

# Filter to your ligands
lr_subset <- lr_pairs %>%
  dplyr::filter(ligand %in% top_ligands)

# View the receptors associated with your ligands
target_receptors <- unique(lr_subset$receptor)
target_receptors
```

### Tgfb1 gave receptor complexes so need to split into gene names

```{r}
target_receptors <- c("Tgfbr1","Tgfbr2","Acvr1b","Acvr1c","Acvr1","Tgfbr","Ccr4","Ackr3")

# Check to see which of these are in muscle_immune
all_genes <- rownames(muscle_immune[["RNA"]])

target_receptors %in% all_genes

target_receptors <- c("Tgfbr1","Tgfbr2","Acvr1b","Acvr1c","Acvr1","Ccr4","Ackr3")
```


### Filter for receptors expressed in receiver cells with an average expression >= 0.2 in >= 10% of cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Extract log-normalized data for receiver cells
receiver_mat <- Seurat::GetAssayData(muscle_immune, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[target_receptors, ]

# Compute average expression and % of cells expressing each receptor
receiver_expr_stats <- data.frame(
  receptor     = target_receptors,
  avg_exp      = Matrix::rowMeans(receiver_mat),             # mean expression
  pct_express  = Matrix::rowSums(receiver_mat > 0) / ncol(receiver_mat)  # fraction of cells expressing
)

# Apply thresholds (>=0.1 expression AND >=10% of cells)
receiver_expressed_receptors <- receiver_expr_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_exp >= 0.2, pct_express >= 0.10)

# Extract receptor names passing thresholds
receiver_expressed_receptors <- receiver_expressed_receptors$receptor
```

### Get matrix of interaction weights between ligands and receptors

```{r, include=FALSE}
lr_network_top <- lr_network %>%
  filter(from %in% ligand_activities_genes_cellchat & to %in% receiver_expressed_receptors) %>%
  distinct(from, to)

lr_network_top_df_large = weighted_networks_lr %>%
  filter(from %in% ligand_activities_genes_cellchat & to %in% receiver_expressed_receptors)

lr_network_top_df = lr_network_top_df_large %>%
  spread("from", "weight", fill = 0)

lr_network_top_matrix = lr_network_top_df %>%
  select(-to) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  magrittr::set_rownames(lr_network_top_df$to)

lr_network_top_matrix <- as.matrix(lr_network_top_matrix)
mode(lr_network_top_matrix) <- "numeric"
lr_network_top_matrix[is.na(lr_network_top_matrix)] <- 0

dist_ligands = dist(lr_network_top_matrix, method = "binary")
hclust_ligands = hclust(dist_ligands, method = "ward.D2")
order_ligands_receptor = hclust_ligands$label[hclust_ligands$order]

dist_receptors = dist(lr_network_top_matrix, method = "binary")
hclust_receptors = hclust(dist_receptors, method = "ward.D2")
order_receptors = hclust_receptors$label[hclust_receptors$order]

order_receptors = order_receptors %>%
  intersect(rownames(lr_network_top_matrix))
order_ligands_receptor = order_ligands_receptor %>%
  intersect(colnames(lr_network_top_matrix))
```

### Clean lr_networs_top_matrix to pass through heatmap

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Remove non-numeric metadata columns (keep drop=FALSE to stay as matrix)
lr_network_top_matrix_clean <- lr_network_top_matrix[, !colnames(lr_network_top_matrix) %in% c("database", "source"), drop = FALSE]

# Convert to data frame and add Receptor column
lr_network_df <- as.data.frame(lr_network_top_matrix_clean)
lr_network_df$Receptor <- gsub("\\.1$", "", rownames(lr_network_top_matrix_clean))

# Collapse duplicate rows by summing
lr_network_df_collapsed <- lr_network_df %>%
  group_by(Receptor) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum), .groups = "drop")  # works if only 1 row

# Convert back to matrix and set rownames
lr_network_top_matrix_clean <- lr_network_df_collapsed %>%
  column_to_rownames("Receptor") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Ensure numeric
mode(lr_network_top_matrix_clean) <- "numeric"
```


## Check change in receptor expression with cachexia

### Kruskal-Wallis test to compare all 3 groups

```{r}
# Genes to test
kw_genes <- c("Tgfbr1", "Tgfbr2", "Ccr2")

# Extract expression + condition
kw_df <- FetchData(
  muscle_immune,
  vars = c("condition", kw_genes)
)

# Initialize results list
kw_results <- lapply(kw_genes, function(gene) {
  # Kruskal-Wallis test
  formula <- as.formula(paste(gene, "~ condition"))
  test <- kruskal.test(formula, data = kw_df)
  
  # Return results in a data.frame
  data.frame(
    gene = gene,
    KW_statistic = test$statistic,
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})

# Combine into a single table
kw_results <- do.call(rbind, kw_results)

# Adjust p-values for multiple testing
kw_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(kw_results$p_value, method = "BH")

# Print results
kw_results
```

### Pairwise comparisons for post-hoc tests

```{r}
# Genes to test
kw_genes <- c("Tgfbr1", "Tgfbr2", "Ccr2")

# Extract expression + condition
kw_df <- FetchData(
  muscle_immune,
  vars = c("condition", kw_genes)
)

# Initialize list to store pairwise results
pairwise_results <- lapply(kw_genes, function(gene) {
  
  # All unique condition pairs
  conds <- unique(kw_df$condition)
  combs <- t(combn(conds, 2))
  
  # Compute p-values and log2FC for each pair
  pw_list <- lapply(1:nrow(combs), function(i) {
    g1 <- combs[i, 1]
    g2 <- combs[i, 2]
    
    # Subset data
    x1 <- kw_df[[gene]][kw_df$condition == g1]
    x2 <- kw_df[[gene]][kw_df$condition == g2]
    
    # Wilcoxon test
    p <- wilcox.test(x1, x2)$p.value
    
    # log2 fold change (mean of group1 / mean of group2)
    log2fc <- log2(mean(x1 + 1e-6) / mean(x2 + 1e-6)) # add small pseudocount to avoid log2(0)
    
    data.frame(
      gene = gene,
      group1 = g1,
      group2 = g2,
      p_value = p,
      log2FC = log2fc
    )
  })
  
  # Combine pairs for this gene
  do.call(rbind, pw_list)
})

# Combine all genes
pairwise_results <- do.call(rbind, pairwise_results)

# Adjust p-values for multiple testing
pairwise_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(pairwise_results$p_value, method = "BH")

# Reorder columns nicely
pairwise_results <- pairwise_results[, c("gene", "group1", "group2", "p_adj", "log2FC")]

# Print results
pairwise_results
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Genes of interest
receptors_genes_macrophages_nk_cells <- "Tgfbr2"

# Get mean expression
avg_receptors_exp_macrophages_nk_cells <- AverageExpression(
  macrophages_nk_cells,
  features = receptors_genes_macrophages_nk_cells,
  assays = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)
```

## Boxplots of receptors

```{r}
Idents(monocytes_macrophages) <- "condition"
Idents(macrophages_nk_cells) <- "condition"



# Create a small data frame directly from the Seurat object
Tgfbr1_df <- data.frame(
  expression = Seurat::GetAssayData(monocytes_macrophages, slot = "data")["Tgfbr1", ],
  condition  = monocytes_macrophages$condition)

Tgfbr2_df <- data.frame(
  expression = Seurat::GetAssayData(macrophages_nk_cells, slot = "data")["Tgfbr2", ],
  condition  = macrophages_nk_cells$condition)



# Basic boxplot with default lines (thin) ONLY PLOTTING CELLS EXPRESSING GENE
Tgfbr1_df_nonzero <- Tgfbr1_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(expression > 0)

ggplot(Tgfbr1_df_nonzero, aes(x = condition, y = expression, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, lwd = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Tgfbr1 (expressing cells only)", y = "Expression", x = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Control" = "white",
    "Early tumour-bearing" = "lightgrey",
    "Endpoint tumour-bearing" = "#666666")) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, lwd = 0.8)  +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 4))



Tgfbr2_df_nonzero <- Tgfbr2_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(expression > 0)

ggplot(Tgfbr2_df_nonzero, aes(x = condition, y = expression, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, lwd = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Tgfbr2 (expressing cells only)", y = "Expression", x = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Control" = "white",
    "Early tumour-bearing" = "lightgrey",
```

# Ligand-to-target gene signaling paths

## Find target genes from highly expressed ligands

### High regulatory ligands "Tgfb1", "Cxcl12"

```{r, include=FALSE}
# From Regulatory potential heatmap
ligands_tgfb1 = "Tgfb1"

# Subset active_ligand_target_links_df and get unique targets
targets_tgfb1 <- active_ligand_target_links_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(ligand %in% ligands_tgfb1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(target) %>%
  unique()

# Chose specific target(s) because the graph won't work well with too many
targets_tgfb1_ecm <- c("Adam19","Chst11","Furin","Itga5","Nedd9","Pdgfc","Pxn","Tgfbi","Tns1")
targets_tgfb1_inflammatory <- c("Ccl3","Tlr2","Casp1","Gbp2","Birc3","Csf1r","Ptgs2","Plaur","Ubash3b")
targets_tgfb1_stress <- c("Cdkn1a","Gadd45b","Dapk1","Hmox1","Txnip","Phlda1","Ulk1","Plk2")
```


## Plot gene regulatory interactions

### Tgfb1 ECM

```{r}
# ---- 1. Calculate the TGFb1 signaling network ----
# ligands_tgfb1 = your vector of TGFb1 ligands
# targets_tgfb1_ecm = your vector of downstream target genes
# weighted_networks = your precomputed weighted network object
tgfb1_signaling_network <- get_ligand_signaling_path(
  ligand_tf_matrix = ligand_target_matrix,
  ligands_all = ligands_tgfb1,
  targets_all = targets_tgfb1_ecm,
  weighted_networks = weighted_networks
)

# ---- 2. Normalize edge weights (optional) ----
tgfb1_signaling_network_min_max <- tgfb1_signaling_network
tgfb1_signaling_network_min_max$sig <- tgfb1_signaling_network_min_max$sig %>%
  dplyr::mutate(weight = (weight - min(weight)) / (max(weight) - min(weight)) + 0.75)

# ---- 3. Prepare edges and nodes ----
edges_df <- tgfb1_signaling_network_min_max$sig[, c("from", "to", "weight")]
nodes_df <- data.frame(name = unique(c(edges_df$from, edges_df$to)))
nodes_df$type <- ifelse(nodes_df$name %in% ligands_tgfb1, "ligand", "target")

# ---- 4. Build igraph object ----
tgfb1_igraph <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges_df[, c("from", "to")],
  vertices = nodes_df,
  directed = TRUE
)

# ---- 5. Plot dendrogram ----
ggraph(tgfb1_igraph, layout = "dendrogram") +
  geom_edge_diagonal(alpha = 0.5, color = "grey50") +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = type), size = 3) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name),
                 size = 3,
                 repel = TRUE,
                 hjust = 1) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# ---- 6. Save TIFF ----
ggsave("dendrogram_muscle_immune_to_muscle_immune_tgfb1_ecm.tiff", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 1200)
ggsave("dendrogram_muscle_immune_to_muscle_immune_tgfb1_ecm.eps", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 1200)
```
